blocks.text: BUTUAN CITY — Police in Caraga (Region 13) arrested three of its top fugitives, including Surigao del Sur’s No. 1 most wanted person, in separate manhunt operations across two provinces on Saturday, Nov. 14. Brig. Gen. Rolindo Suguilon, director of the Police Regional Office 13 (PRO-13), said local police units carried out the arrests armed with arrest warrants in Surigao del Sur and Agusan del Norte. In Tandag City, Surigao del Sur, the city police collared a 56-year-old suspect identified only as alias “Loloy,” a resident of Barangay Pandanon, who tops the province’s list of most wanted persons.
